title: Counterfactual Transition Graphs: Evaluating Cross-Class Transition Quality
abstract: arXiv:2608.23164v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Counterfactual (CF) explanations for time-series classifiers are usually evaluated one example at a time: what minimal edit flips this single window's prediction? We argue that the more informative question for diagnostic interpretability is structural: how does the classifier connect its own classes to each other?   We propose a counterfactual transition graph (CGT) in which each node is a class and each edge weight is the CF reliability of the transition from one prototype to another under a proximity aware retrieval sweep. On a six-class hand-movement task, we induce a CGT that reveals a non-trivial topology, which is not predicted by the binary confusion matrix: it shows that counterfactual reachability does not align with classifier accuracy and even runs counter to it (Spearman $\rho=-0.37$ over the 15 pairs), i.e. the boundaries the classifier separates most confidently are among those an in-distribution edit can least often cro

translated_title: 反事实转换图：评估跨类别转换质量
translated_abstract: 时间序列分类器的反事实（CF）解释通常逐个样本进行评估：什么最小编辑能翻转这个单一窗口的预测？我们认为，对于诊断可解释性，更具信息量的问题是结构性的：分类器如何将其自身类别相互连接？我们提出了一种反事实转换图（CGT），其中每个节点代表一个类别，每条边的权重是在邻近感知检索扫描下，从一个原型到另一个原型的转换的CF可靠性。在六类手部动作任务中，我们生成一个CGT，它揭示了一种非平凡拓扑结构，该结构无法由二元混淆矩阵预测：它表明反事实可达性与分类器准确性不一致，甚至与之相反（15对中Spearman ρ=-0.37），即分类器最自信区分的边界，往往是分布内编辑最不可能跨越的边界。
tldr: 该论文提出反事实转换图（CGT），用于揭示时间序列分类器中类别间的结构性转换关系，并发现反事实可达性与分类准确性呈负相关。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Counterfactual Transition Graphs (CGT) to reveal structural cross-class transitions in time-series classifiers, showing that counterfactual reachability is negatively correlated with classifier accuracy.
